newsitem.title: USA: Universal names chief of recreation group.
newsitem.headline: Universal names chief of recreation group.

text.p: Universal Studios on Thursday appointed Cathy Nichols as chairman and chief executive of Universal Studios Recreation Group.
Universal is 80 percent owned by Canadian beverage and entertainment company Seagram Co Ltd.
Nichols replaces Ron Bension who left Universal as part of a restructuring in November last year.
Nichols has served 22 years at management consulting firm McKinsey & Co where she was the first woman elected director. She will oversee all of Universal Studios' recreation businesses.
The company has theme parks in Hollywood and Florida and in 2001 plans to open its first theme park outside the United States in Osaka, Japan.

"After working for many years in a variety of businesses, I am excited by the challenge of focusing my efforts in this area and joining Universal's talented top management team," Nichols said in a statement.

"As the recreation business evolves into a market-driven, customer-focused organization, we will look to develop significant growth and profit opportunities while maintaining our distinct identity as world-class family entertainment destinations," she added.
